def solve(facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']
    n=len(jobs)
    ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]
    index={x:i for i,x in enumerate(ids)}
    full=(1<<n)-1
    best=None
    def visit(mask,time,order,starts,cost):
        nonlocal best
        if mask==full:
            key=(cost,time,tuple(ids[i] for i in order))
            if best is None or key<best[0]:
                best=(key,order[:],starts[:])
            return
        if best is not None and cost>best[0][0]:
            return
        for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
            bit=1<<i
            if mask&bit: continue
            predmask=0
            for p in j['predecessors']: predmask|=1<<index[p]
            if predmask&mask!=predmask: continue
            start=max(time,j['release'])
            end=start+j['duration']
            visit(mask|bit,end,order+[i],starts+[start],cost+j['weight']*max(0,end-j['due']))
    visit(0,0,[],[],0)
    key,order,starts=best
    return {'order':[ids[i] for i in order],'starts':starts,'finish':key[1],'weighted_tardiness':key[0]}

def check(answer,facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs); ids=[j['id'] for j in jobs]
    index={x:i for i,x in enumerate(ids)}; full=(1<<n)-1
    optimum=None
    def visit(mask,time,order,starts,cost):
        nonlocal optimum
        if mask==full:
            k=(cost,time,tuple(ids[i] for i in order))
            if optimum is None or k<optimum: optimum=k
            return
        for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
            b=1<<i
            if mask&b: continue
            required=0
            for p in j['predecessors']: required|=1<<index[p]
            if required&mask!=required: continue
            s=max(time,j['release']); e=s+j['duration']
            visit(mask|b,e,order+[i],starts+[s],cost+j['weight']*max(0,e-j['due']))
    visit(0,0,[],[],0)
    if not isinstance(answer,dict): return False
    if set(answer.keys())!={'order','starts','finish','weighted_tardiness'}: return False
    order=answer['order']; starts=answer['starts']
    if not isinstance(order,list) or len(order)!=n or not isinstance(starts,list) or len(starts)!=n: return False
    if set(order)!=set(ids): return False
    t=0; cost=0
    for pos,x in enumerate(order):
        i=index[x]; j=jobs[i]
        for p in j['predecessors']:
            if order.index(p)>=pos: return False
        s=max(t,j['release']); e=s+j['duration']
        if starts[pos]!=s: return False
        t=e; cost+=j['weight']*max(0,e-j['due'])
    return answer['finish']==t and answer['weighted_tardiness']==cost and optimum==(cost,t,tuple(order))
